mapper.sql: s.id, s.name, s.category_id, s.area, s.city, s.score, s.min_price, s.distance, s.tag, s.cover, s.address, s.business_hours, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time, c.name as category_name
mapper.select:
select
from shop s left join category c on c.id = s.category_id
order by s.distance_meters is null, s.distance_meters asc, s.id asc order by s.min_price asc, s.id asc order by s.score desc, s.id asc
limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from shop s left join category c on c.id = s.category_id

select
from shop s left join category c on c.id = s.category_id where s.id = #{id}

select
from shop s left join category c on c.id = s.category_id where s.id in #{id}
mapper.update: update shop set score = #{score} where id = #{id}
